description: Small positive and negative controls for metric/judge/reference suitability. No statistical calibration or human approval is implied.

cases.user_input: Can I claim hotel reimbursement without a receipt? State the documented condition.
cases.reference: Hotel accommodation is reimbursed up to KGS 8400 per night, and only with a receipt.
retrieved_contexts: The company reimburses hotel accommodation up to KGS 8400 per night only with a receipt.
cases.rationale: The policy reimburses hotel accommodation only with a receipt, so a receipt requirement is supported. A mismatch is a suitability warning, not proof of an application defect.

cases.user_input: Can I claim hotel reimbursement without a receipt? State the documented condition.
cases.reference: Hotel accommodation is reimbursed up to KGS 8400 per night, and only with a receipt.
cases.response: Hotel reimbursement is available without a receipt.
retrieved_contexts: The company reimburses hotel accommodation up to KGS 8400 per night only with a receipt.
cases.rationale: A missing receipt must not be accepted by the documented condition. This negative control prevents accepting every paraphrase.

cases.reference: The employee's direct manager approves the paid-leave request.

cases.rationale: Accept the documented approval role expressed with policy attribution. A mismatch may expose reference-only evaluation limitations or an overly literal judge; it does not by itself prove judge error.
